ns2:section.sectionText: [Expanded title: Legal Issues in Library and Other Information Settings] Meets all day (8am-4:50pm, with lunch break) for 3 Friday/Saturday sessions: June 16-16, June 29-30, July 13-14. 2 or 4 hours (be sure to enroll in your desired credit amount; the registration system will enter the default hour of "1", so you will need to change it). Elective course for Graduate Certificate in Special Collections (see http://www.lis.illinois.edu/academics/programs/mbms/certificate1); however, permission of Marianne Steadley is not required for LIS students.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to Library & Information Science major(s).
